title: Braskem Board Approves Out-of-Court Reorganization Request
subtitle: The Board of Directors has authorized the petrochemical company to file for out-of-court reorganization.
excerpt: Braskem's Board of Directors approved the filing of an out-of-court reorganization request, according to a statement released to shareholders and the market.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Braskem's Board of Directors approved the filing of an out-of-court reorganization request on Monday (24).
